result.summary: Found one major layout issue: overlapping text on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the "Popular right now" section, where the delivery time and delivery fee are printed on top of each other and are difficult to read.

issues.description: The delivery time and price text for the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card overlaps and renders on top of each other, making "25-30 min" and "€0 delivery" illegible.
issues.suggestion: Place the delivery time and delivery fee on a single line with proper spacing, or stack them vertically within a flex column so the two labels never collide.
